question: Why did the error rate go up on 10 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Upstream identity-db is experiencing degraded performance, causing auth service errors.
why_chain: identity-db returns HTTP 503 to auth service (E5, E8, E9)
auth service experiences timeout errors (E6, E7, E9)
identity-db is investigating degraded performance (E8, E9)

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume for auth service did not change significantly (E3)

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a new deployment of the auth service.
ruled_out.reason: No new deployment is indicated by the evidence (no deployment record found)

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a change in the auth service configuration.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth rose from 0.39% to 5.84% (+1390%), with a change point at 2026-03-10T13:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.33).
At the same time, request volume for service auth stayed about the same (1114 per 5 min before, 1326 per 5 min after, +19%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth rose (90 ms before, 163 ms after, +81%).
Upstream identity-db returning HTTP 503 for auth (auth; 1 min after the change; record R016; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
auth: ERROR upstream identity-db timeout after 3 retries (auth, us-east; 12 min after the change; record R017; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR upstream identity-db timeout after 3 retries (auth, ap-south; 18 min after the change; record R018; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
identity-db status page: investigating degraded performance (auth; 30 min after the change; record R020; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR upstream identity-db timeout after 3 retries (auth, eu-west; 22 min after the change; record R019; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (alerts) lines up in time (1 min after the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Investigate and fix the identity-db performance issue
Monitor identity-db performance and alert on any future degradation
